violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SLICED CHEESE AT 50F, SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 46F, MOZZARELLA AT 47F, CHICKEN AT 47F, AND SALAMI AT 50F IN THE RIGHT TWO-DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS TO ANOTHER COOLER. PIC WILL ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34F-38F.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE RIGHT TWO DOOR PREP TOP AT 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC CONTACTED A REPAIR TECHNICIAN DURING INSPECTION WHOM WILL COME THE SAME DAY AS OF INSPECTION TO REPAIR THE COOLER. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS TO ANOTHER COOLER. PIC WILL ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34F-38F.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the FRONT SERVICE AREA being used TO DUMP ICE AND COLLECT WATER INTO SAUCE PAN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at handwashing sink IN FRONT SERVICE AREA used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH SIGNAGE FOR POSTING.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: FOCACCIA GLAZED WITH TOMATO SAUCE AT 70-77F IN 4 HOURS ON KITCHEN COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOCACCIA DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE COOLED FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: GARLIC IN OIL AT 51F IN 3 DOOR PREP TOP (PIZZA STATION); CHEF’S SALAD AT 53F ON FRONT SERVICE COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control (TPHC) as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED GARLIC IN OIL DURING INSPECTION; CHEF’S SALAD INCLUDED IN TPHC DOCUMENTATION, TO BE DISCARDED AT 6:00PM.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control (TPHC) with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): OBSERVED NO DOCUMENTATION FOR VARIOUS PIZZAS AND CHEF’S SALAD ON FRONT SERVICE COUNTER .
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC COMPLETED DOCUMENTATION AT TIME OF INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food items: OBSERVED ESTABLISHMENT NOT UPDATING TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL LOGBOO; NO FOOD ITEMS ON TIME WERE OBSERVED WITH 4 HOUR TIME MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. PIC UPDATED LOGBOOK DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL FOODS ON TIME MUST HAVE FOUR HOUR TIMEFRAME DOCUMENTED/LABELED. PLEASE ENSURE THAT ALL FOODS ON TIME START AT 135F OR ABOVE, TIMES ARE DOCUMENTED APPROPRIATELY, AND THAT FOODS ARE DISCARDED AFTER 4 HOURS.

violations.corrective_action: EHS PROVIDED EDUCATION. PIC SLIT OPEN BAGS OF THAWING SALMON DURING INSPECTION.
